abilities.name: Drunken Stagger
abilities.text: Roll a number of dice equal to the value of this ability. Until the end of this fighter's activation, for each roll of 1, subtract 1 from this fighter's Move characteristic (to a minimum of 1), then for each roll of 2+, add 1 to this fighter's Move characteristic.

abilities.name: Mighty Kick
abilities.text: Until the end of this fighter's activation, the next time this fighter finishes a move action within 1" of an enemy fighter, pick a visible enemy fighter within 1" of this fighter. Allocate a number of damage points to that fighter equal to the value of this ability.

abilities.name: Vicious 'Eadbutt
abilities.text: Pick a visible enemy fighter within 1" of this fighter and roll a number of dice equal to the value of this ability. For each roll of 3+, allocate a number of damage points to that fighter equal to the value of this ability.

abilities.name: Noxious Vomit
abilities.text: Roll a number of dice equal to the value of this ability. For each roll of 5+, pick a visible enemy fighter within 6" of this fighter. Allocate D3 damage points to that fighter.

abilities.name: Squiggly-beast Followers
abilities.text: Roll a dice for each visible enemy fighter within 3" of this fighter. On a roll of 2+, allocate 1 damage point to the fighter being rolled for.

abilities.name: Troggoth Regrowth
abilities.text: Remove a number of damage points from this fighter up to the value of this ability.

abilities.name: Troggoth Regrowth
abilities.text: Remove a number of damage points from this fighter up to the value of this ability.

abilities.name: Wall Crawler
abilities.text: Until the end of this fighter's activation, do not count the vertical distance moved when this fighter is climbing.

abilities.name: Crushing Grip
abilities.text: Pick a visible enemy fighter within 1" of this fighter and roll a number of dice equal to the value of this ability. For each roll of 4+, allocate 2 damage points to that fighter.

abilities.name: Paralysing Venom
abilities.text: Until the end of this fighter's activation, after each attack action made by this fighter, roll a dice. On a roll of 2+, until the end of the battle round, the target of that attack action cannot make move actions or disengage actions.

abilities.name: Dragged Victim
abilities.text: Pick an enemy fighter within 1" of this fighter. Remove that fighter from the battlefield and set them up within 1" of this fighter. Then, this fighter makes a bonus attack action against that fighter.

abilities.name: Horrific Stench
abilities.text: A fighter can make this reaction after they are targeted by a melee attack action but before the hit rolls are made. Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of that attack action, to a minimum of 1.

abilities.name: Relentless Destroyers
abilities.text: When a friendly fighter with this battle trait makes a melee attack action, the target cannot add 1 to their Toughness for being in cover.
